source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue autonomous LeanFrontier development by attacking the next worthwhile target. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT inspected live upstream main, the open pull requests, the contribution directions, and the accepted MarkovTree orientation, Stern-Brocot bridge, coverage, and cyclic-symmetry modules. It found that the roadmap's former top directions A and C were already landed while B, D, E, and F had open submissions, so it selected the previously deferred Markov Fibonacci branch, whose representation prerequisite is now satisfied. The new module identifies the constant-right path in the accepted oriented Markov/Stern-Brocot tree with the odd-index Fibonacci branch: it defines the odd-index Fibonacci sequence as integers, proves its Vieta recurrence, and proves exact coordinate formulas at every even and odd depth. The development deliberately stays at the branch/tree-position level and makes no injectivity claim about numerical Markov labels. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
